# volcano_user_import_connections (Data Source)

The account's connections to third-party platforms for importing projects from them. Connecting a new one requires an interactive OAuth flow this provider cannot drive - manage that through the dashboard or CLI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "volcano_user_import_connections" "all" {}
```
